hero.description: Hawk Stars is an NGO for Education, Innovation and Social Development. We connect young people from the heart of Portugal with Europe — through Erasmus+, humanitarian action, culture and a training centre we are building in Pinhel.
hero.ring_label: Europe's stars around the Hawk Stars mark

mission.title: A group of friends from Pinhel, thinking at the scale of Europe
mission.body: Our main objective is to promote and develop social, cultural, digital, artistic and youth competencies, and to foster lifelong learning through international projects and non-formal education — for locals and for everyone who comes to visit.
mission.body_2: Blue and yellow are the colours of our city and of the European Union. The Hawk embraces the world, from the global to the local.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Common sense and respect for cultural diversity.

mission.image_alt: The PINHEL letters in front of the castle

erasmus.title: Erasmus+ & youth mobility
erasmus.description: Youth exchanges, volunteering with the European Solidarity Corps, traineeships and cooperation partnerships across Europe.
erasmus.image_alt: Participants of a youth exchange on a boat

village.title: Global Village
village.description: Turning a vacant building in Pinhel's historic centre into an International Training Centre for learning, culture and social innovation.
village.image_alt: Render of the International Training Centre

humanitarian.title: Humanitarian action
humanitarian.description: When the war in Ukraine began, we filled trucks. Solidarity is where our story restarted — and it stays at our core.
humanitarian.image_alt: Volunteers sorting humanitarian aid in a warehouse

culture.title: Art & culture
culture.description: A social-impact art gallery, festivals and events that bring international artists and audiences to the Beira Interior.
culture.image_alt: A summer evening with project participants

impact.title: One district. One cause. 90 tonnes of hope.
impact.description: In the spring of 2022, the founders of EuroHawk reunited with partners and the firefighters of the Guarda district to send humanitarian aid to Ukraine. This is what solidarity looked like.

eurohawk.title: EuroHawk is born
eurohawk.description: A youth association formed entirely by young people from Pinhel — version 1.0 of Hawk Stars.

festival.title: Hawk Festival
festival.description: Around 1,400 festival-goers a day, 500 campers and 27 artists — a cultural milestone for the Guarda district.

ukraine.title: Together for Ukraine
ukraine.description: The founders reconnect to send 5 trucks of humanitarian aid across 30,342 km.

foundation.title: Hawk Stars is founded
foundation.description: Officially established on 8 August 2023 as an NGO for Education, Innovation and Social Development.

future.title: A 30-year vision
future.description: Building the Pinhel Global Village International Training Centre — a hub for social innovation.

village.title: Pinhel Global Village
village.description: We are transforming a vacant building in the historic centre of Pinhel into a multidisciplinary centre for training, social innovation, culture, gaming and digital creation — bringing the world to the Beira Interior.
village.image_alt: Exterior render of the International Training Centre
village.image_alt_2: Coworking space in the International Training Centre

gallery.title: Life inside our projects
gallery.image_alt: Photo from a Hawk Stars project

involve.title: Be part of something bigger
involve.description: Hawk Stars is built by people who believe in community, culture and positive change. There is a place for you.

member.title: Become a member
member.description: Vote in the General Assembly, help shape our strategy and represent Hawk Stars at home and abroad.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.description: Join local and international activities, take part in youth exchanges and earn a Youthpass.

donate.title: Donate
donate.description: Fund the Training Centre and our humanitarian work. Every contribution is published transparently.

erasmus.title: Find an opportunity
erasmus.description: Explore Erasmus+, the European Solidarity Corps and other EU programmes for young people.
